summary: Ares Strategic Income Fund filed an 8-K announcing it could not convene its annual meeting due to a lack of quorum; the meeting was adjourned to July 22, 2026. No special-situation event is involved—this is a routine procedural delay with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, restructuring, or any other special category. The filing merely updates shareholders on the adjournment and continued solicitation. There are no deal terms, price, premium, or strategic action. This is a standard administrative filing, not a special situation.
